quest.title: Connor's Brew
quest.description: The Dawn Winery's Connor requires three Flaming Flower Stamens.

talks.objective: Give three Flaming Flower Stamens to Connor

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, I heard someone needs Flaming Flower Stamens...

dialogues.speaker: Connor
dialogues.text: Yes, that was a commission I sent out. I must say, that was rather quick...

dialogues.speaker: Connor
dialogues.text: So, have you gathered the three Flaming Flower Stamens that I need?

response.speaker: Connor
response.text: Well then, give them to me as soon as you're done gathering them. I have wine to brew.

dialogues.speaker: Connor
dialogues.text: Yes, this will do. Please accept this small token from me as thanks for your help.

dialogues.speaker: Connor
dialogues.text: While I'm not certain if we can brew anything sufficiently special with these ingredients...

dialogues.speaker: Connor
dialogues.text: But I'm sure that this will be a memorable brewing experience nonetheless.
